purpose: Explain chip-regime reversal and recurring forecast strengths/weaknesses; diagnostic, not new model selection
status: Specified before diagnostic results; prior six-season model results already known; no independent holdout
trace_accounting: Base XI plus ordinary captain bonus plus direct TC/BB increment minus hits. Settle exactly the same chosen action without chip to isolate mechanical bonus; do not interpret action/path changes as direct causal chip effects.
matched_decisions: Every model on identical pre-GW reference-policy state from each archived regime. On scheduled chip rounds solve both scheduled chip and no chip. On other rounds solve no chip only. Evaluate immediate realized score; do not propagate or claim season policy returns. Reference decisions must reproduce archived choices.

scenario_groups.minutes_change: minutes6-minutes12: <=-15 falling; >=15 rising; otherwise stable; missing separate
scenario_groups.fixtures: 0 excluded from forecast diagnostics; 1 single; >=2 double/multiple
scenario_groups.venue: home or away single fixtures; mixed/multiple separate
scenario_groups.opponent_defence: mean lagged goals conceded <=1 strong; >1.6 weak; otherwise middle
scenario_groups.opponent_attack: mean lagged goals scored <=1 weak; >1.6 strong; otherwise middle
scenario_groups.team_attack: lagged goals scored <=1 weak; >1.6 strong; otherwise middle
scenario_groups.elo: mean team-opponent <-100 underdog; >100 favourite; otherwise balanced

metrics: Forecast bias, MAE, RMSE on all scheduled players and fixed reference top60 population; within-scenario top10 realized points and 8+ precision with at least10 players (all top20). Errors aggregate within season then equal-weight seasons. Rank metrics equal-weight rounds within season then seasons.
consistency: Show paired seasonal differences and win counts; recurring ranking pattern requires >=12 eligible rounds in at least5 seasons and positive paired mean in >=5 seasons. Descriptive only, overlapping groups and multiple comparisons; no gates fitted.
limitations: Inherited historical price/status/calendar proxies and modern chips/FT rules
Only immediate matched-state effects, no causal real-world identification
Six reused seasons; model family and questions motivated by earlier results
